title: CSS Path Animation | Smooth Moving Objects Along a Custom Path! 🚀✨
description: Want to animate objects along a custom path using pure CSS? 🎯 In this tutorial, I'll show you how to create a smooth looping animation where images follow a predefined SVG path—all without JavaScript! 🚀
